documents.title: Blog final: The State of AP 2026

versions.author: c_grant
versions.content:
# The State of AP 2026: what 400 finance leaders told us

1. 64% of finance leaders say their AP team spends too much time on manual invoice entry (73% at companies
   without AP automation).
2. Teams that use AP automation close their books 2.3 days faster on average (6.3 vs 8.6 days).
3. ERP change is a trigger: 45% plan an ERP change in 2027.
4. The pain isn't about size: it's about automation.

Methodology: online survey of 400 US finance decision-makers at companies with $50M-$1B revenue, recruited from
opt-in B2B panels, October 19-30, 2026; results are not weighted.

documents.title: Press release final: State of AP 2026

versions.author: c_monica
versions.content:
# Arbeline research: nearly two-thirds of mid-market finance teams are still buried in manual invoice entry

DENVER, Nov. 6, 2026 -- A new survey of 400 U.S. finance decision-makers from Arbeline, the AP automation
company, finds that 64% say their AP team spends too much time on manual invoice entry, rising to 73% at
companies without AP automation, and that teams using AP automation close their books 2.3 days faster on
average. 45% plan an ERP change in 2027.

Methodology: online survey of 400 U.S. finance decision-makers at companies with $50 million to $1 billion in
revenue, recruited from opt-in B2B panels, October 19-30, 2026, fielded by Penmore Research; results are not
weighted.
